selection: postscore; chosen because query-only PC gain over no-C is one of just two cases

normal.observation: Mostly static already-curved wood; few visible new extraneous fragments; no clear bending progression.

no_c.observation: Large floating wood-textured pieces appear/disappear; people and curved main wood mostly stationary.

query_only.observation: Floating curved wood-textured pieces remain at multiple moments; no clear bending progression.

interpretation: PC gain is partial artifact suppression, not demonstrated correct bending. Does not justify calling native-Q modulation a generally effective process mechanism.
